body:

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Heeya Cold!

Thank your for taking the time to create this report.
There are always players with different views on how to build defensive structures. By the looks of it, he messed with your defense and you messed with his'. From his point of view you were the one that was griefing and he was angry about it. I don't want to say it was the right thing to be rude to you, but it was understandable.
So I would say issuing a warn to remind him that rudeness is not tolerated is enough of a punishment.

I'll leave the report open in case you want to add anything.

Regards Flo/resepignev
